issues.summary: The section asserts that clause 6.2 of INSO 23682 cites INSO 23733 with number «۶.۳.۳۳», treating it as a probable typo for ۶.۳.۳. Evidence item S23682-075, which transcribes that exact in-text reference, unambiguously reads «بند 6.3.3 از INSO 23733:1403». Per the review rules the transcription is trusted at character level; the printed number is 6.3.3 and no typographic discrepancy exists.
issues.explanation: Trusting the evidence transcription (as required), «6.3.3» is the printed clause number, not «6.3.33». The claim that the standard printed «۶.۳.۳۳» and the parenthetical explanation about right-to-left rendering are therefore unsupported and create a false impression of an error in INSO 23682 and in the INSO 23733 clause-numbering scheme.
issues.quote: به INSO 23733:1403 با شمارهٔ «۶.۳.۳۳» (به ترتیب خواندن راست‌به‌چپ) ارجاع شده؛ چنین بندی بعید است و احتمالاً غلط تایپی برای ۶.۳.۳ است
issues.suggested_fix: Delete the «۶.۳.۳۳» observation entirely. Rewrite the bullet as: «ارجاع بند ۶.۲: به INSO 23733:1403 بند ۶.۳.۳ و INSO 13245:1398 ارجاع شده (S23682-075).» Remove the parenthetical RTL-reading claim and the «احتمالاً غلط تایپی» note; neither has evidentiary support.
